name: Vilnius Gediminas Technical University
summary: Technical university in Vilnius; 19 bachelor's and integrated degrees open in English, from civil and aviation engineering to IT and business.

ib.text: Entrance score from maths, a science or social-science subject and English, each normalised to your grade scale; 60% overall minimum. Recorded interview. English test unless your studies were fully in English.

lastYear.text: EU apply by 1 August; non-EU by 15 June

notes: EU citizens pay €3,250 for business and creative programmes and €4,201 for engineering, IT and technology; non-EU students pay more. The fees page says all EU students can apply for government funding.
Application fee €100, then a €200 registration fee with the first tuition payment; the page says the gap since your last completed education should be at most three years.
Construction and Real Estate Management, Logistics and Transport Management, Cybersecurity and Communication Technologies and the five Maritime Academy degrees are taught in Lithuanian only.
